default.access_notes: Family planning services available at public health facilities, private clinics, and pharmacies across Kenya. Ask about your needs.
default.partner_dynamics: Partner involvement varies. You can access services independently. All services are confidential. Discuss with your provider.

nairobi.access_notes: Wide access across the city. Public facilities, private clinics, pharmacies, Marie Stopes, Family Health Options Kenya (FHOK), and community centers provide confidential services.
nairobi.partner_dynamics: Women can access services independently. Many clinics offer confidential services without partner consent.

garissa.access_notes: Services available at Garissa Referral Hospital, Iftin Sub-County Hospital, and mobile clinics in Daadab camps. Community health workers available.
garissa.partner_dynamics: Discussing family planning with your husband may be helpful. Female providers available. All services are confidential.

kisumu.access_notes: Good access at Jaramogi Oginga Odinga Teaching and Referral Hospital. Mobile clinics available.
kisumu.partner_dynamics: Mix of independent and partner-involved care. Youth-friendly centers available.

mombasa.access_notes: Services at Coast General Hospital, private clinics, and pharmacies.
mombasa.partner_dynamics: Increasing independent access. Confidential services available.
